name: From All Sides – Catalyst Spatial Sound Forum
description: This year's annual festival brings together Berlin's sound community and Catalyst (Institute for Creative Arts and Technology) tutors for performances, talks and installations. It features immersive sound installations and live and fixed media concerts, encouraging dialogue about the sound/space continuum. A site-specific spatial audio system will be installed in Saal 4 at Funkhaus, tuned to the room's architecture.
